base_member_text: [L86-L92] (MED/initialization ordering) The sole initialization of constantRainfall on non-master ranks is conditional on rainfall_update first being called with t<=dt, leaving it undefined if the first update occurs later.
audit_member_text: [L22-L25,L86-L92] (MED/MPI initialization contract) Only the master initializes constantRainfall, and workers receive it only when the first update satisfies t<=dt, so restart or nonstandard first-call timing can leave the worker flag undefined.

base_member_text: [L36-L60,L92-L97] (MED/input-domain contract) The time-series path passes nrainfallrate and the file timestamps directly to LINEAR_INTERP without locally requiring at least a usable number of records or ordered, distinct times.
audit_member_text: [L36-L60,L92-L97] (MED/unchecked interpolation input) The file-driven path passes nrainfallrate and timestamps directly to LINEAR_INTERP without checking that at least the required number of records exists or that times are ordered.

base_member_text: [L22-L25,L86-L100] (HIGH/MPI initialization contract) Non-master ranks return before rainfallrate and the input arrays are allocated, while rainfall_update can subsequently interpolate into those components; this file only broadcasts the scalar constantRainfall flag.
[L41-L54] (LOW/file-error handling) The rainfall file open has no iostat check, and the read-error branches rely on report_file_read_error to terminate before partially filled arrays are used.

audit_member_text: [L25,L31-L37,L66-L67] (LOW/reinitialization lifecycle) rainfall_init allocates all rainfall arrays unconditionally and provides no cleanup or already-allocated guard for a second initialization.
